title.narrative: To enhance data quality and support evidence-based policy and planning, UNICEF in 2024 continued to support Eritrea’s Ministry of Education (MOE) in rolling out a quality and timely educational management information system (EMIS) database. This will provide the evidence base to guide the education sector’s transformation and improve learning outcomes.
